name: 👋 Welcome Bot
description: Community onboarding — hello, server/user/role/bot info, avatar, invites, auto-welcome & goodbye.

embeds.title: 👋 Hello, ((userName))!
embeds.description:
Welcome to **((guildName))**! We're glad to have you here.

There are currently **((guildCount))** members.

embeds.title: 📊 ((guildName))
embeds.description:
**🆔 Server ID:** ((guildId))
**👑 Owner:** <@((guildOwnerId))>
**👥 Members:** ((guildCount))
**📅 Created:** ((guildCreatedAt))
**🚀 Boost Level:** ((guildBoostLevel|0))
**💬 Channels:** ((guildChannelCount))
**🏷️ Roles:** ((guildRoleCount))

options.name: user
options.description: User to get info about (default: yourself)

embeds.title: 👤 User Info
embeds.description:
**Username:** ((opts.user|userName))
**🆔 ID:** ((opts.user|userId))
**🤖 Bot:** ((opts.user|isBot|No))
**📅 Created:** ((opts.user|createdAt))
**📆 Joined:** ((opts.user|joinedAt))
**🎨 Roles:** ((opts.user|roles))

embeds.title: 🎨 Role Info
embeds.description:
**Name:** ((opts.role|name))
**🆔 ID:** ((opts.role|roleId))
**🎨 Color:** ((opts.role|color))
**📊 Position:** ((opts.role|position))
**👥 Members:** ((opts.role|memberCount))
**📌 Hoisted:** ((opts.role|hoisted|No))
**🔧 Managed:** ((opts.role|managed|No))

embeds.title: 🤖 Bot Info
embeds.description:
**Name:** Bot Creator
**🆔 ID:** ((bot.id))
**📡 Latency:** ((bot.ping|?))ms
**⏱️ Uptime:** ((bot.uptime|?))
**🌐 Servers:** ((bot.guildCount))

options.description: User to show the avatar of
